verdict.rationale: MoonPay's docs include an OpenAPI codegen guide ('Generate type-safe API clients from the OpenAPI specification'), which implies an official machine-readable spec exists. However, the evidence never gives the spec's download URL, and probes of the common paths (openapi.json, swagger.json, .well-known) all returned 404. That shows the spec isn't at the standard locations; it does not prove the spec is absent. Missing for 10: a documented download location for the spec, confirmation that it is publicly fetchable without auth, and independent or hands-on confirmation that the file can be retrieved.
